summary.text: Paul Morgan is the Democratic candidate for Idaho State Senate District 23 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Todd Lakey (R).

paragraphs.text: Paul Morgan graduated from Sabino High School and from Northern Arizona University in 1993.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he said he spent 25 years as an R&D engineer at Micron Technology and lives in rural Ada County.
Morgan was also the Democratic candidate for Idaho State Senate District 23 in 2024, when incumbent Todd Lakey won the general election.
He named healthcare access in rural counties and educational excellence in a rural environment as policy areas he is passionate about.
